promise.text: after I log in at 8:00 am, I will walk to the first inspection station and say “¿Puede mostrar el lote?”

b.advice: Link the greeting to the exact moment you log in (cue). Use an implementation‑intention: If I log in at 8:00 am, then I will walk straight to the nearest inspection station, say “Buenos días, ¿cómo va la línea hoy?” and ask one specific follow‑up (e.g., “¿Hay alguna desviación hoy?”). Keep the follow‑up ready so it takes <30 seconds. After the exchange, note “done” on your tally card – the act of checking off serves as a tiny reward and reinforces the habit stack. If the day is very busy, the floor version is simply “Buenos días” (no question).

t.lesson: After you log in at 8 am, walk to the first inspection station and say, “¿Puede mostrar el lote?” (Can you show the batch?). Then note “done” on your habit card. The phrase uses the cognate “lote” (batch) and the pattern “¿Puede + verb?” making it easy to remember and say in under 30 seconds.
